contract.reader: A student or engineer who has followed the series to the eigenvalue test and wants to design a first state-space controller
contract.problem: How to choose feedback gains so that the plant's eigenvalues land where the specifications need them, how to make the output track a reference, and what such a design silently assumes
contract.outcome: Write the closed loop A - BK; test controllability; translate overshoot and settling requirements into target eigenvalues; compute K by matching coefficients or Ackermann's formula; compute a reference gain and know why integral action is more robust; know the roles of actuator limits, observers, noise, sampling and LQR
contract.contribution: One plant (the series' mass-spring-damper) carried from specification to gains, reference gain, integral action and observer, with simulated results, a table of the force cost of faster eigenvalues, and a closing account of the series against its objectives
contract.evidence: Derivations in the text; one NumPy script with its output; simulations reported in two tables and the text; Ackermann (1972), Astrom and Murray (2021), Chen (2013), Franklin, Powell and Emami-Naeini (2019), Ogata (2010)
contract.limitations: Single-input systems only; LQR and Kalman filtering named, not developed; discrete-time design pointed to, not done

findings.location: Section 1 closed-loop polynomial (1280 and 360 px); opening C and D, Section 2 det C, Section 3 desired polynomial and k2, Section 4 phi(A), Section 5.3 kI (360 px)
findings.problem: Side-by-side displays wider than the column with no scroll cue; at 1280 px det(sI-(A-BK)) ends at 's^2 -'; at 360 px several design results are hidden
findings.whyItMatters: The closed-loop polynomial is the bridge from the law to the design; phone readers also miss C, the controllability conclusion, k2 and the phi(A) definition
findings.action: Put each pair on separate lines (aligned/gathered block or two displays)
findings.acceptance: On new captures the Section 1 determinant is fully visible at 1280 px and none of the listed equations is cut at 360 px, light and dark

findings.problem: Mentions that sample-and-hold delay erodes damping without linking From Signal Processing to Digital Control, which derives it and links back to this section
findings.whyItMatters: Readers implementing the controller digitally have no path to the sampling-rate guidance
findings.action: One clause in Section 6.4 linking to /blog/from-signal-processing-to-digital-control (its Sections 4 and 5)

findings.problem: No caption and no accessible title (facts.json: 1 SVG without title); block label shows a literal 'k_r'
findings.whyItMatters: Screen-reader users get nothing; the raw label looks like a typo
findings.action: Add accTitle/accDescr and a caption; label the block 'reference gain' or use a Unicode subscript
findings.acceptance: facts.json reports 0 SVG figures without a title, the diagram has a caption and no label shows an underscore
